data.headline: We bridge the gap between college and career.
data.subheadline: StimuliiQ is an internship-training platform for India's B.Tech, Degree, Diploma, MCA, and MBA students. We teach the way industry works — live mentors, real projects, verifiable certificates — so your first job doesn't depend on your college tier.

data.heading: Why we exist
body: Every year, hundreds of thousands of Indian engineering graduates struggle to land their first job — not because they lack intelligence, but because college curriculums don't match what companies actually need.

Our founders — engineers from Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Pune — lived that gap themselves. In 2021 they built StimuliiQ to close it: a system where students learn by building, are mentored by people who do the job, and graduate with proof employers can check.
Our mission: give every Indian student — regardless of college tier — access to the training they need to build a real tech career.

heading.title: How the system works for you
heading.subtitle: One guided journey from first click to first offer.

items.title: Discover the right program
items.description: Browse 30+ project-based programs across software, data, cloud, and design — or book a free counselling slot and let a mentor guide your choice. Transparent pricing, 0% EMI, no hidden fees.

items.title: Learn live and on-demand
items.description: Our learning portal combines scheduled live sessions with industry mentors and recorded video lessons you can rewatch anytime. Track your own progress and attendance in one place.

items.title: Build real projects
items.description: Every program is structured around industry-grade projects — reviewed by working engineers, not graders. Your portfolio becomes the proof employers actually look at.

items.title: Earn a verifiable certificate
items.description: Finish your assessment and receive a certificate with a unique ID and QR code. Any employer can verify it on our public verification page in seconds — no fake credentials, ever.

items.title: Get placed
items.description: Resume reviews, mock interviews, and direct referrals into our network of 200+ hiring partners. We stay with you until you sign your offer — that's how we get to 89%.

heading.title: What's inside the platform
heading.subtitle: Everything a student needs — nothing they don't.

items.title: A structured learning portal
items.description: One dashboard for lessons, live classes, assignments, progress, and attendance — built for focus, not distraction.

items.title: Mentors who do the job
items.description: Active engineers and data scientists from top companies — people who ship code, review yours.

items.title: Projects, not just lectures
items.description: Assignments and capstone projects modelled on real industry work, individually evaluated with feedback.

items.title: Certificates employers can check
items.description: Every certificate carries a unique ID and QR code, instantly verifiable on our public portal.

items.title: A real placement engine
items.description: Referrals to 200+ hiring partners, interview prep, and placement tracking — not a PDF of job links.

items.title: Student-first pricing
items.description: Priced for students in India, with 0% EMI plans and a 7-day no-questions-asked refund policy.

data.heading: Don't take our word for it.
data.subheading: Every StimuliiQ certificate is publicly verifiable. Employers — paste a certificate ID or scan its QR code and see the result instantly.

items.title: 7-day refund
items.description: Not satisfied? Full refund within 7 days, no questions asked.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.description: The price you see is the price you pay — 0% EMI available.

items.title: Your data, protected
items.description: DPDP-compliant privacy: consent-first analytics, no data resale.

items.title: Verified outcomes
items.description: Ratings and reviews come from enrolled students only.
